retrievals.assessment: The complete official Rhythm PDF reproduces the 9 July 2025 announcement: sponsor-reported topline results from a 28-person placebo-controlled Phase 2 acquired-hypothalamic-obesity study and plans to seek regulatory advice. It does not establish general-obesity efficacy, UK authorisation, NICE or NHS access, lawful UK supply or clinical approval.

The complete official Rhythm PDF reproduces the 4 August 2026 announcement: preliminary open-label Phase 2 acquired-hypothalamic-obesity findings from 11 enrolled participants, with seven contributing the week-16 BMI analysis. It does not establish comparative or long-term benefit, general-obesity use, UK authorisation, NICE or NHS access, lawful UK supply or clinical approval.
